purpose: Repair the three retained v4 failures and the reading source-selection bug; this version has no unseen sample.

authorization.source: Original authorization for at most 500 real provider requests across all versions, never reset.

policy.selectionVsLiveCap: Manifest reserves 6 calls per turn (42) only to include all three cases. The actual provider boundary is capped at 41; native reading at 8. Every selected case stays in the denominator if the cap interrupts execution.
policy.commute: Not rerun in v5; v4 result stays historical.

nativeAuditPolicy.sourceLabels: Independent frozen vocabulary; selected IDs must join to fresh actual playlist metadata, negated, uncertain or conflicting labels stay unverified. Production matching is never imported.
nativeAuditPolicy.scope: same-task edit, preserved requested prefix, changed unlocked sequence, accepted ranking, freshly fetched source-label support. This does not establish initial-scene suitability, audio language, listening quality, full catalog recall or full playback.
